full_prompt_en: A square, intricately painted fantasy landscape looks through a dark rocky opening toward a wide valley under moonlight. The arching rock ceiling occupies the top edge and upper corners, its underside almost black with small warm striations. On the left side of the opening, a mass of orange and gold cloud curls upward like a glowing wall, each rounded fold outlined by darker ocher. At the center of the sky, a pale round moon shines through layered charcoal and blue-gray storm clouds. Below it, distant hills and a thin strip of water recede toward the horizon. The valley floor opens into winding green and ocher fields, crossed by a light path that leads from the lower center into the middle distance. A large dark tree anchors the left foreground, its irregular canopy silhouetted against the glowing cloud. At the right, a steep golden rock face and autumn-toned trees rise above the valley; dark shrubs and uneven stones frame the lower corners. Tiny marks along the path suggest a distant traveler or small forms, but remain indistinct. The image layers several kinds of light: cold moon glow falls into the central distance, while the orange cloud and right cliff hold a warmer illumination. Fine stippling and curling lines texture clouds, rock, and foliage; the distant landscape is smoother and more hazy. The dark arch compresses the top and sides around the luminous center, giving the view a theatrical sense of depth and discovery.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、刻画繁细的幻想风景画从幽暗岩石开口望向月下宽阔山谷。弧形岩顶占据上缘和两个上角，底面几乎全黑，仅带细小暖色条纹。开口左侧，一团橘金色云像发亮墙面般向上卷起，每道圆润折叠都有较深赭色勾边。天空中央，浅圆月从层叠炭灰与蓝灰暴风云中发光。其下，远山和一条细水带向地平线后退。谷底展开蜿蜒绿与赭色田块，一条浅色小路从下部中央引入中景。左前景一棵大深色树固定画面，不规则树冠在发光云前形成剪影。右侧陡峭金色岩壁和秋色树木升在谷上方；深色灌木与不平石块围住下方两角。路上的极小笔点似暗示远处行者或小形体，但无法辨清。图像叠加多种光：冷月光落入中央远方，橘云和右侧岩壁则带较暖照明。细点描和卷曲线条给云、岩石与枝叶上肌理；远景地貌更平顺、朦胧。深色岩拱从顶部和两侧压向发亮中心，让视野具有舞台化的纵深和发现感。
style_prompt_en: An intricate painted landscape frames a luminous cool center with deep, textured shadow at the top and sides. A large warm orange-gold cloudlike volume coils along one edge, opposing blue-gray and charcoal passages around a small pale light source. Fine stipples, curled contours, and engraved-looking marks build tactile near surfaces, while distant green and ocher bands soften into haze. A narrow light path winds through the lower middle and pulls the eye inward. Edge treatment shifts from hard, dark foreground silhouettes to diffuse far contours. Warm and cool illumination coexist, creating a layered glow without a single flat wash. The composition has a theatrical aperture, dense margins, and a spacious receding interior; its rhythm alternates heavy shadow, swelling warm forms, and small luminous openings.
style_prompt_zh: 繁细绘画风景以顶部及两侧的深色有肌理阴影围住明亮冷色中心。一团大型暖橘金色云状体量沿一侧卷起，对照小块浅光源周围的蓝灰与炭灰段落。细点、卷曲轮廓和刻纹般笔痕建立可触的近景表面，远处绿与赭色色带则在雾中柔化。下部中央一条狭窄浅色曲线把视线向内牵引。边缘处理从硬朗深色前景剪影变为模糊远方轮廓。暖冷两种照明并存，产生层叠光感，而非单一平涂。构图具有舞台般的开口、密集边缘和宽阔后退内部；节奏在厚暗影、膨胀暖形和细小发光间隙之间交替。
theme_en: A moonlit valley seen through a dark rocky opening
theme_zh: 从幽暗岩洞口望见的月下山谷
name: William Blake
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
